title: Publish Android Wake pairing fix and verify live pair-token
description: GitHub main is the source of truth. In the currently open Bridge AI Studio Build workspace, sync latest machxanht/BridgeChatgpt main including commit ac641bb2f19eaccad229db28d78f9899bb8e9ebd (server/androidWake.ts). This fix removes the hard requirement for BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN/BRIDGE_ANDROID_WAKE_SECRET by using a process-local random signing key only when env secrets are absent; never hard-code any secret into source. Run npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, and production startup smoke. If all pass, Publish the updated Bridge deployment. AFTER Publish, verify the live endpoint GET /api/android-wake/pair-token with same-origin Bridge headers (Origin/Referer matching https://bridge-ai-mission-control.ai.studio and X-Bridge-UI: browser-dashboard) returns HTTP 200, ok=true, and a token beginning bridgewake. Do not expose or report the full token. Then re-register exact Studio target resource_url=https://aistudio.google.com/u/3/apps/15c1d80d-6265-47e1-bdf2-e30fb7bf430c in workspace_id=workspace-proj-default if Publish reset registry state, send Studio Relay heartbeat, and report completion. Do NOT touch Android Accessibility/orange-banner behavior in this task. Do not redesign UI.
